title: Privileged operator proofkit: acceptance criteria and onboarding artifacts for SAML/RBAC/KMS
creator: Aisha Raman
description: This PRD defines a 'Privileged Operator Proofkit' — a package of artifacts, automated checks, and sign-off criteria used to onboard operator teams and customers for private/VPC deployments that require SSO (SAML), RBAC, audit logs, and customer-managed KMS/HSM. The goal is to reduce onboarding time by providing reproducible verification steps and a checklist for security reviewers, operator admins, and account teams. Scope includes: SAML federation metadata exchange, RBAC role matrix and least-privilege mappings, audit log retention & integrity checks, KMS/HSM key import/rotation and operator roles, emergency access procedure, and signed acceptance artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence 'Proofkit Checklist' document exists and is linkable from Console onboarding flow
SAML federation test harness demonstrates successful SP metadata import and assertion validation for at least 3 IdP vendors (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin)
RBAC role matrix mapped to internal operator personas, with automated tests verifying constraints for 10 example tasks
Audit log pipeline validated end-to-end: append-only storage, tamper-evidence checks, and 90-day retention configuration
KMS/HSM onboarding documented with step-by-step key import, rotation, and signed attestations; HSM quorum test executed
Operator emergency-access runbook validated with a successful drill and recorded evidence
Security review signed by 'Markus Lee' and legal readiness note present
Onboarding can be completed by an SRE in < 4 hours using the proofkit artifacts and scripts
notes: Trade-offs: keeping HSM onboarding reproducible required abstracting provider-specific steps into adapters; that increases maintenance. Scope decision: exclude full airgap package in this iteration, but include checklist items to escalate to 'airgap onboarding' project. Compliance note: evidence artifacts must be exportable for audits.

test_scenarios: SAML: IdP initiated and SP initiated login flows with assertions validated and replay blocked
RBAC: Ensure read-only operator cannot perform key-rotation; enforce policy via end-to-end tests
Audit: Simulate log tampering attempt and verify tamper-evidence alerts trigger to PagerDuty
KMS/HSM: Import customer-wrapped key, perform rotation, verify both old and new versions decrypt expected ciphertext
Emergency: Simulate lost operator keys and validate recovery via documented emergency-access flow
verification_steps: Run 'saml-harness.sh' against Okta/Azure/OneLogin and confirm 0 failures
Deploy audit pipeline in staging and run integrity checker; collect signed digest
Perform HSM key import in staging HSM emulator and capture rotation proof
Run emergency-access drill, capture video and signed notes from operator oncall
